content_of_post_to_comment:
Hi guys

I've noticed that my usage to YouTube has changed I started to use that every single day even when I'm walking I listen to some podcast or something similar

And when I'm trying to skip it for a day it becomes really hard, and I started seeing that as a problem when I started to watch videos instead of work and that's really bad , I know that entertainment is important but I prefer to find other way to entertain myself

As someone who doesn't use social media since 2019 , I always say that YouTube does not count but I guess I need to put it on black list

Do you have any experience similar to mine ?

And have do you deal with it ?

And thank you
comment: YouTube is tricky because it can feel productive even when it's just entertainment, especially with podcasts playing in the background. I'd try removing autoplay and keeping it off your home screen before blacklisting it completely. Also, walking without something playing might feel boring at first, but you may get used to having some quiet time. The goal isn't to eliminate boredom every time it shows up.
